eps.ov: After his showdown with Melon, Legoshi finds himself at the mercy of the ocean. Meanwhile, Haru encounters an unfortunate scene that rouses her suspicion.
While the drama club tries to get their interspecies script approved, Melon's interest in Haru grows. Later, Legoshi reunites with his canine friends.
Jack confides in Legoshi about his struggles in school, while Yahya visits Deshico for a lead. Melon's fascination with Haru takes a dangerous turn.
Legoshi awakens with a start to find Haru missing. The mayor approaches Louis with a meaty proposition. Pina stirs up trouble during rehearsal.
Struggling to understand a herbivore's perspective, Juno seeks acting advice from Louis. Meanwhile, trouble brews in the Black Market alleys.

eps.t: Upon a Nest of Dried Noodles
eps.ov: A quick meal turns into a moral conflict for Bill. Meanwhile, a string of unexplained interspecies attacks erupt around the city. Louis and Haru catch up.
On the night of the Odd Soul Festival, Legoshi meets Melon in Haru's place, determined to stop him once and for all — but the villain pulls a gun on him.
With Melon on the loose, Legoshi arms Haru with self-defense gear — but he has bigger things to worry about. There's a warrant out for his arrest!
After a charged encounter, Haru bonds with Gosha. Louis reveals his true feelings to his fiancée. Melon asserts his dominance over the Shishi-Gumi.
Set on challenging Melon, Legoshi enters the Turf War, but must first pass a deadly quiz. Meanwhile, Deshico makes a critical discovery in his lab.
Louis's butler reveals the truth behind Ogma's behavior. Meanwhile, Melon incites the crowd and a riot breaks out. Can Legoshi survive the night?
Despite winning the Doku-Gumi's approval, Legoshi must still face the Inari-Gumi's foxy boss. The mayor drops a bombshell that blindsides Louis.
